display_name: Phase1 hierarchical source waveform prior pilot
description: Fit 12-component source-only hierarchical Gaussian prior (two waveform subclusters per six clean-F pseudo classes), compare fixed blind posterior with original six-component prior.
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 physical GPU2, source-only prior fit and fixed inference; TF32 disabled

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: IQ [2,256], six clean-F pseudo classes split into 2 waveform clusters with class/global covariance shrinkage
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: No source true TX labels, U_s truth, V or test; high-confidence clean-F pseudo classes and paired source IQ only
data.validation_ref: 384 previously explored RX8 source records: 64 per impaired scene, evaluate clean-F pseudo label agreement
data.leo_config_ref: fixed Phase1 source cache epoch19; clean IQ prior fit on 8192 source train IDs

permissions.query_use: Only source fit clean IQ and frozen-F pseudo classes; source evaluation clean-F pseudo targets; no U_s truth, V or test
permissions.claim_scope: Source physical IDs previously observed in other views; pseudolabel agreement not independent true test accuracy; mixture may hallucinate identity

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen blind channel model, six-component source prior and ground F; source-only new prior fit; DURA loaded after fit as comparison only.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Blind action SHA256 0ef60a205f785bda45f9936d519e925179dbbddeef2fd6cd285a83b02a284338 and source prior SHA256 5e35516d54d3e3d1d1749933861f290c1f87c8ffdb4b863d2f9819914135ceb9
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: Predeclared two subclusters per six pseudo classes, 16 PCA dimensions, deterministic two-means, covariance .4 subgroup + .4 class + .2 global plus ridge; fixed source RX8 comparison; no automatic test.
